Commentary.Commentary: Okay then! 3-0 to India with 2 matches to go. We now head to Colombo for what is left of this tour - 2 ODIs and a T20I. Can the Lankans show any fight? Join us on Thursday, 31st August, 2017 at 1430 local (0900 GMT) for the fourth ODI. Until then, you can catch all the action from the Eng-WI and Ban-Aus Tests. Adios! Take Care!

Victorious Indian skipper, VIRAT KOHLI says that small targets are a bit tricky but is not too fussed with the top order flopping just for a couple of games. Does not want to look too much into the collapse in the previous game and the failures today. Stresses that people need to be patient with the evolving middle order which is learning. Praises Jasprit Bumrah and calls him amongst India's top bowlers at the moment and adds that he has taken bowling in the death overs like a fish takes to water. Definitely will look to experiment in the coming ODIs, he says.

Sri Lankan skipper CHAMARA KAPUGEDERA says that the reason to bat first was that he felt that it was a good wicket, so wanted to put some runs and then defend them. On being asked about 29 overs of dot balls in the batting, he admits that rotating the strike was an issue and it needs to be discussed in the team meeting. States that he enjoyed the captaincy in spite of being under pressure.

JASPRIT BUMRAH has been named the MAN OF THE MATCH for his maiden five-wicket haul in ODIs. States that it is always good to make a comeback after a break, coming back refreshed. Feels that it was a different wicket as the last one was slow but this one here was a bit of movement with the new ball. Adds that it is a good feeling to be contributing to the team's cause.

The Lankan bowling was not wayward to be honest. But it was not threatening either. Akila Dananjaya kept a lid on the Indians and so did Siriwardana but nothing much from the rest. Malinga and Fernando started off well but could not quite induce enough pressure. Stay tuned for the presentation...

Forgettable match again for Sri Lanka. This has been that sort of a tour for them, right from the Tests. Apart from the second ODI, they have not made India sweat and poor batting displays are not helping them. It was Siriwardana with a half century in the previous game while it was Thirimanne with a gritty 80 today, but they need the seniors to step up.

Earlier in the day, India produced yet another brilliant bowling display - this time led by Jasprit Bumrah who grabbed his maiden 5-for in ODIs. Every game, someone or the other steps up for the visitors. Excellent signs for the future with everyone doing well consistently.

The Indians would be a bit worried regarding the type of dismissals today - pretty loose and just throwing them away. But considering that the game has been won, it might not be too much of a thought. But consistent failures for Rahul and Jadhav might just tempt the Indian think tank to look at the reserves, given that the series has been done and dusted.

Easy win for the Indians, marred a bit by the unsporting Sri Lankan crowd. They were in a bit of bother during the run chase but calm and cool Rohit Sharma shepherded them through with an unbeaten 124. Giving him good company and playing second fiddle was MS Dhoni, who made an unnoticed 67 in a partnership of 157.

This ends the game. A full toss down the leg side, Dhoni looks to flick but gets a bit of a top edge which clears the infield. India take the required single and WIN BY 6 WICKETS AND 29 BALLS TO SPARE! They also gain an unassailable 3-0 lead in the series with 2 matches to go!
VISHWA FERNANDO to bowl possibly the final over of the game...
Action replay of the previous delivery. Just a run needed...
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for another single.
Outside off, punched through the covers for one more.
Short and outside off, crunched through the covers where Vishwa Fernando makes a good tumbling stop. Two runs taken.
Wide outside off, Rohit slashes hard but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a run.
150-run stand is up between these two...
A length ball around off, worked to short mid-wicket for a quick single.

The match referee ANDY PYCROFT has a word with the managers from both the teams. Out come the umpires to the middle, followed by the players. The section which was creating nuisance has been cleared and a whole army of policemen is monitoring the crowd. Rohit and Dhoni now come onto the field. 8 runs needed...here is Dushmantha Chameera...
The umpires are shaking hands with the players. The players are being taken in and the stadium is being cleared.
No improvement in the scenario. Dhoni and Rohit take the time and sit lazily on the ground, just relaxing. This is not helping anyone. Every player would want this game done and dusted with.

Uh oh... not acceptable. The frustrated crowd is throwing bottles onto the ground and there is a holdup in play. Completely agree with the frustration of the Sri Lankan supporters but not quite sure this is the right way to vent it out.
Comes down the track and pushes it to long on for a single. 12 from the over, just might be the last one coming up next.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
SIX! When he hits, they stay hit. Floated on middle, Dhoni comes down the track and smacks it way over long on! 9 more needed now, from 38 balls. Dhoni moves to 60 from 79 balls.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.

FOUR! TAKE THAT! Full on middle, Rohit gets down and sweeps it powerfully through mid-wicket for a boundary! 16 more needed from 40 balls now. Rohit moves to 121 from 142 balls with his 16th boundary. The stand is worth 141 from 169 balls.
Around off, defended from the crease.

That is actually a terrific stop from Malinga. Short and wide outside off, Dhoni crashes this behind point. The ball seems destined to reach the fence but Lasith Malinga chases it down from third man, sticks out his right leg and kicks the ball away. Saves the boundary but that is inviting a lot of injury. Two runs taken.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid on.
A length ball outside off, watchfully defended.
65th ODI Fifty for MS Dhoni, 18th against Sri Lanka!
FOUR! SPANKED! Fine way to get to your half century. Short and wide outside off, Dhoni pounces on it and crashes it over point for a boundary. Maintains his Bradmanesque average in ODI run chases...
Landed outside off, steered to third man for a single.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA is back on.
Full and wide outside off, MS reaches out and drives the ball to cover.
Around off, Sharma looks to defend but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards long on for a single. The stand moves to 130 from 160 balls.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Around off, stays back in his crease and blocks.
Wider outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single. End of a good spell from Dananjaya - 10-0-38-2.
Short and wide outside off, cut through point for a run.
Outside off, dabbed to backward point.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Around middle, defended to the leg side.
POWERPLAY 3 now. 5 fielders allowed outside the circle. Does it matter?
Short and outside off, punched through mid on for one more.

In the air... NOT TAKEN! Difficult chance though. Tossed up on middle, Rohit comes down the track, looking to go big but miscues it high the air. Chamara Kapugedera takes a start from short mid-wicket, but is a bit late. In the end, he circles a bit under the ball, ends up getting away from it and then dives forward but cannot reach the ball. A single taken.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked.
Down the leg side, worked through square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked.
Full and outside off, Dhoni comes down the track and drives it towards mid off but Siriwardana dives to his left to stop it.
MILNDA SIRIWARDANA to bowl now.
Full again, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Comes down the track and defends.
Landed around off, defended from the crease.
AKILA DANANJAYA is back on.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Outside off, a play and a miss from Rohit.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Easily done. Full on middle, Rohit flicks it wide of mid on for a boundary! 36 more needed from 75 balls now. Rohit moves to 113 from 126 balls with his 15th boundary. The stand moves to 121 from 134 balls.
Flicks this away for a run.
Short and outside off, punched behind point for a single.
Full and wide outside off, driven uppishly but in the gap through cover for one.
Full on middle, pushed down the ground. Mid on quickly gets across to his left and stops the ball.
Quietly works this down the leg side for a run.
MISFIELD. The wheels are coming off the chase now. Full and outside off, MS drives it straight to cover who fumbles and concedes not one but two. Dhoni moves to 40 from 57 balls.

FOUR! SMOKED! If you are bowling short, you have got to get it higher, around the shoulder. Not around the waist. Pulled through square leg with disdain for a boundary. 46 needed from 82 balls now. The stand moves to 111 from 127 balls.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Outside off, angling away, left alone.
Flicked to deep square leg for a run.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Pushes this wide of mid on for a single.
Full on middle, Sharma looks to flick but gets a leading edge to point.
100-run stand is up!
SIX! Easily done. A short ball, down the leg side, pull-helped over backward square leg for a maximum!
VISHWA FERNANDO is back on.
12th ODI ton for Rohit Sharma.
There it is! Century for Rohit! His 12th in ODIs, third against Sri Lanka! A length ball outside off, calmly guided to third man to get to that landmark. His first on Lankan soil.
Rohit on 99...
Full and wide outside off, eased through the covers for a single. Finally Rohit gets the strike.
Short and outside off, punched straight to short cover.
Outside off, left alone this time.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.

MISFIELD, FOUR! Things going from bad to worse for the Lankans. A short ball around off, Dhoni swivels and pulls it behind square leg. The ball goes straight to Akila Dananjaya in the deep but he is kind of tentative to field the ball and it slips right beneath his hands to the fence.

DRINKS are on the field. Rohit might not like that. Just a run away from his ton. India cruising along. Sri Lanka need wickets, which is an understatement. 64 needed at 4 an over with 6 wickets in hand. Plenty of batsmen to come.
The wrong 'un around leg, RS misses his defense and is hit on the pads.
A tad short, Sharma flicks this behind square leg and gets a couple to move to 99.
Comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and chips it towards short mid-wicket.
Quicker one on leg stump, blocked from the crease.
Short and around off, punched straight to point.
Tossed up around middle, Rohit stays back and defends.
Outside off, left alone.
Another long hop, down the leg side, pulled towards long leg for another single.
Short and wide outside off, sliced uppishly towards third man for one more.
Fullish on middle, Rohit works it wide mid on and sets off for a single. The fielder misfields and Rohit wants the second but Dhoni is not too keen.
Short and outside off, cut straight to sweeper cover for a run.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA gets a change of ends.
Slower through the air outside off, Dhoni skips down and with soft hands pushes towards mid off for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Punched off the back foot down the track for a single.
SIX! That travels the distance! Tossed up around middle, Sharma dances down and mows it over cow corner for a maximum. Rohit moves to 94!
Served around middle, turned to mid-wicket.
Dhoni gets to the pitch of the ball, eases it on the leg side and gets a single.
Sharma presents a solid front foot defence.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Served around leg, nudged through square leg for a single.
Tossed up around leg, Dhoni leans ahead to defend but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
A touch shortish around middle and off, Rohit camps back and punches it past the bowler to long on for a single.
Served around off, spinning away, played off the back foot to covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rohit stands tall and punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! One bounce and across the fence! Full on middle and leg, Sharma clubs it over wide mid on for a boundary. He is cutting loose now.
Tucked to mid-wicket off the back foot.

A touch ahead of a length wide outside off, Sharma slices it past the diving Hasaranga at point. Dananjaya at third man hares to his right and slides to make a good stop. Saves a couple of runs for his side. Wanindu tried his best there but failed to get his hand to it.

Back of a length delivery outside off, punched solidly to covers. Chameera is making the same mistake he did in the second game - Guilty of being too short at times. This time though he got away with it.
Length delivery outside off, tapped on the off side.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA comes back on!
Comes down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, paddled very fine. The Indians notice that it is Malinga chasing the ball from short fine leg and take the second on the throw.
Full and wide outside off, pushed through the covers where the substitute WANINDU HASARANGA misfields with his dive and concedes one.
Very full and wide outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Comes down the track and eases it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Very full and way down the leg side, flicked behind square on the leg side for a run.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, flicked away for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! SMASHED! A short ball on middle, Dhoni swivels and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary! Dhoni surpasses former Indian skipper Mohd. Azharuddin in the tally of runs in ODIs for India. FOURTH in the list now.
Full and wide outside off, eased through the covers for an easily-run couple. 99 more needed from 137 balls now.
Around middle, blocked back to the bowler. Top over. Just one from it.
Stays back this time and eases it to long on for a single.
Comes down the track now, eases it towards long off but Kusal Mendis dives to his right from short extra cover to stop it.
Short and outside off, punched straight to cover this time.
Full and around off, Dhoni comes down the track and flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around off, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Another block from his crease.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
That should never have been a single. Dhoni just pushes this towards mid on and takes Kapugedera on, who is resting on his heels.
Last throw of the dice for the Lankans. LASITH MALINGA is back on.
Full and outside off, pushed through mid on for a run.
Outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
50-run stand comes up! And at great pace too. In just 56 balls.
Outside off, pushed through mid off for one.
Full and down the leg side, swept through mid-wicket for a run.
Typical Dhoni. A long, lunge out, get to the pitch of the ball, push it in the gap at cover and dart across for a single. 109 more needed from 155 balls now.
Kapugedera continues to hold Malinga back. For how long? This match and series are slipping away...
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! SWEET! Full and outside off, Rohit just pushes this wide of mid off. So good is the timing that the ball races to the fence!
Comes down the track a touch and drills it to long on for a run.
Around off, Rohit stays back and tucks it behind square leg for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, eased down to long on for a run. 8 from that over, largely untroubled.
Very full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler. Nearly chips it back.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a run. The stand is worth 40 from 45 balls now. India back in the driver's seat.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single to bring up INDIA'S 100.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Rohit goes back and punches it behind point for a boundary! 119 more needed from 166 balls now.
Full and outside off, Dhoni comes down the track and eases it to long off for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully kept out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, blocked in front of short leg now.
Full and outside off, blocked towards short mid-wicket.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
There you go. Just what Rohit needed. Pushes this down to long on for a single.
Mid on gets pushed back now. Backward square leg comes in. Too defensive captaincy.

FOUR! Up and over! Nicely done. Tossed up around off, Rohit comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and just eases it over mid on for a boundary! Moves to 60 from 71 balls with his 11th boundary. The stand moves to 30 from 33 balls. 127 more needed from 176 balls now.
Around off, an arm ball, punched off the back foot towards cover.
Comes down the track, is seen by Siriwardana who shortens his length, Rohit looks to work it to the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid on.
MILINDA SIRIWARDANA into the attack now. Replaces Chameera.
Comes down the track but is beaten in flight and is hit on the pads.
Comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
Full and around off, Rohit looks to defend but gets a leading edge to the off side. A run taken.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a single.
Comes down the track and works it straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. 13 runs from the over!
FOUR! STUPENDOUS! Another short ball, down the leg side and this time Rohit pulls it brutally behind square leg for a hat-trick of boundaries!
33rd ODI Fifty for Rohit Sharma, 6th against Sri Lanka!

FOUR! Half century for Rohit Sharma! He has played a gem of an innings. And that is why he is a special player. On a pitch where most of the batsmen have struggled, he has looked sublime. This is a short ball and he pulls it with ease though square leg for consecutive boundaries. He will know that the job is only half done as of now. Can he get the big one?
FOUR! That is a delectable shot. Walks a couple of steps towards the bowler and then flicks the half volley wide of mid on for a boundary!
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Pitches the ball right up to Dhoni who wrists it wide of mid on for a single.

FOUR! That is a welcome boundary for India! Short and outside off, Rohit camps back in a flash and crunches it through the covers for a boundary. Moves to 43 from 61 balls with his 7th boundary. This stand is worth 11 from 17 balls. 146 more needed from 192 balls now.
A full toss wide outside off, sliced behind point for a couple.
This is on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off again, Dhoni gets across and gently works it to the leg side for a run.
Tossed up outside off, Sharma waits for the ball and then eases it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, Rohit comes forward and defends it to the off side.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
That hurries Dhoni. It is a length delivery outside off and MS stays back to defend but the ball bounces steeply and the keepr-batsman has to hop to defend. Gets a bottom edge behind.
A short ball down the leg side, Sharma looks to pull but is cramped for room. The ball goes off the inner half of the bat through fine leg and he takes the single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

A bouncer outside off, Rohit ails out of the shot but the ball climbs out of nowhere and Niroshan Dickwella leaps to stop it one-handed. Brilliant. India were sloppy in the field earlier while on contrary, the home side has been brilliant so far.
Loose shot. Short and wide outside off, Rohit slashes hard but does not move his feet and is beaten.
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
Full and outside off, Dhoni comes down the track and blocks.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
THAT STAYED LOW! Around off, Rohit watches it carefully, sees it shoot low, then pushes it to long on for a run.
A full toss on middle, punched down to long on for a single. Baffling captaincy. A long on for a new batsman.
MS Dhoni is the new man in. Can he continue from where he left off in the second ODI?

OUT! Dananjaya strikes again! This is Jadhav's second ball that he faced. First one was the googly and this time it's the classical leg spin. Tossed up on middle, Jadhav kneels down to sweep but misses and gets rapped on the back thigh. Looks plumb and the umpire immediately raises his finger to the Sri Lankan appeal. This was a poor choice of shot from Kedar. The pressure was building on India as the previous over from Chameera was a maiden. Jadhav's poor show continues. The Islanders are on top currently. 157 needed off 209 balls!

Time for a drinks break! India have been rocked hard by the spirited Lankan side. Their bowlers have been disciplined and are reaping fruits for it. The visitors need a partnership to get back on track.
Full again, just outside off, nicely kept out. A MAIDEN for Chameera.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Full and outside off, nicely blocked out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and outside off, tempting to drive, Rohit resists and lets it go.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA comes on from the other end now.
The wrong 'un now, on the pads, Jadhav does not pick it at all and looks to flick, missing and getting hit on the pads. 3 runs and a wicket from Dananjaya's opening over.
KEDAR JADHAV walks in at number 5, replacing Rahul.

OUT! Straight to the man! The bowling change works. It is not this ball which has got the wicket but the ones before this. Dananjaya has been foxing the batsmen and drops this one slightly short, around middle. Rahul immediately  senses a scoring opportunity and goes back to pull but finds Lahiru Thirimanne at deep mid-wicket. He was not looking at his best tonight and departs for a scratchy 17. 157 more needed from 217 balls now.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
Flighted outside off, Lokesh looks to drive but is beaten.
Outside off, Rahul stays back and defends.
Full and outside off, Rohit looks to flick, anticipating a leg break, but it is the conventional off break and the ball goes off the leading edge to cover. A single taken.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA is back on. Nope. Change of mind. It is last game's hero - AKILA DANANJAYA.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

MIX-UP, SAFE! Nervous moment for Rahul. He taps this towards cover-point and sets off for a single. But then he stops. However, Rohit is always eager for the single and races across. Rahul has no option but to go now and somehow manages to get across to the other end as there is a bit fumble in the field.
Outside off, angling in, tucked towards short mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! What a shot! On a length outside off, Rohit jumps out of his crease and slashes it over cover for a boundary! Sharma moves to 31 from 41 balls with his 6th boundary.
Landed outside off, Rohit looks to defend but gets a bottom edge.

FOUR! That will make him feel a lot better! On a length outside off, a touch wide, Rahul stands tall and punches it through the covers for a boundary! 10 runs from the over and India get to their 50. The stand moves to 32 from 41 balls. 167 more needed from 228 balls now.
Full and wide outside off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Pitched outside leg, Rohit misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Fernando appeals but there is nothing in it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Make that one more inside edge. Seems to be Rahul's night. On a length outside off, Rahul gets across a touch, looks to punch this through the off side but gets a thick inside edge which goes past the stumps to the fine leg fence.
Outside off, left alone.

Another inside edge for Rahul. He is looking a bit tentative out there. Full  and outside off, Rahul gets across and looks to punch but gets a thick inside edge which goes to fine leg. A single taken.
Fuller and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

EXCELLENT FIELDING! That can lift the Lankans a bit. It is the substitute, WANINDU HASARANGA. The ball is utter rubbish, short and wide, at a military medium pace of 123 kph outside off, Rohit crashes this through point but Hasaranga dives to his right and stops the ball cleanly.
Outside off, a bit wide, Sharma waits for the ball and then guides it to third man for a single.

FOUR! That will ease the pressure a bit. A short ball around middle, Rohit swivels and pulls this through square leg. There is a fielder in the deep but he is a bit wide, at mid-wicket and his dive cannot prevent the boundary. 179 more needed from 239 balls now. The stand is worth 20 from 30 deliveries.

POWERPLAY 2 has been signalled. 4 fielders allowed outside the circle till the 40th over but Sri Lanka have chosen only 3. It has been a good Mandatory Powerplay for the hosts, picking up 2 wickets and conceding only 35 runs.
Flicks this away for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
That is a good single. Lokesh pushes this through the covers and gets across to the other end. For him, right now, the best seat is at the non-striker's end with the ball moving a bit.

On a good length outside off, Rahul looks to force this through the off side but gets a thick inside edge which goes onto his pads but past the leg stump. On another day, that would have hit the stumps.

EDGED, FOUR! This was coming. Mathews had bowled 5 dots in a row and the last one would have probably induced something from the batsman. Rohit looked to drive but the length was not the right one. There was no feet movement either and the ball flew wide of the diving first slip fielder to the third man fence. Rohit moves to 20 from 30 balls with his 4th boundary.
STAT ALERT - This could be the reason why Kapugedera has brought Mathews on. He has dismissed Rohit 6 times in ODIs - No bowler has got rid of Rohit more often.
Short and wide outside off, Sharma slashes hard but finds point.
Outside off, stays low a touch, punched straight to cover.
Full and closer to the off stump, Rohit defends it towards cover.
Outside off, played straight to point.
On a length outside off, a bit wide, moving away, left alone.
ANGELO MATHEWS comes on to bowl now. A bit of a surprise as he usually does not bowl much these days. Just a slip in place for him.
Outside off, left alone.

Down the leg side, Rohit misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads to the leg side. Fernando tries to distract the umpire with an LBW appeal but gets nothing. A leg bye taken. The stand moves to 10 from 16 balls. 189 more needed from 253 balls now.
Works this behind square now on the leg side for a single.

SRI LANKA TEAM CAMP - Well, this has come as a bit of a shock for the Lankans. Dinesh Chandimal was hit on the arm while batting earlier today and has not taken the field. In fact, he has been ruled out of the game. He has suffered a HAIRLINE FRACTURE on his left arm, which might not mean good news for the remainder of the tour either.
Tries a repeat of the delivery which got Kohli but every time one cannot be lucky. LR flicks this half volley on the leg stump through square leg and gets off the mark with a couple.
This time the defense is better as Lokesh blocks it.
On a good length around off, Rahul looks to work it through the leg side but the ball curves in, takes him by surprise and he somehow manages to push it back.
Another compact forward defense to end the over. Not a bad start from Chameera.
Closer to the off stump, angling in, watchfully defended.

UPPISH, BUT SAFE! Point was almost in action there. A bit fuller outside off, Sharma goes for the drive but the ball moves away, takes the outside edge and goes wide of the substitute WANIDU HASARANGA at point to the third man fence. The fielder does well to stop it with a slide. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Fine shot. Fractionally short in length outside off, Rohit punches this on the up through cover-point for a boundary! The ball was a bit wide and got the treatment.
Outside off, left alone.
On the pads, Chameera is lucky to get away with that as Rohit flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
First bowling change of the night. DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA replaces Malinga. The new-ball bowlers have done their job with breakthroughs. Can Chameera make use of the platform?
BEATEN! On a length outside off, this time Lokesh feels for it and nearly edges it to the keeper. Back-to-back maidens for Fernando and this one is a WICKET MAIDEN!
Closer to the off stump this time, angling away again, watchfully let go.
Similar to the first ball Rahul faced, angling away, a bit too wide to be played, shouldered arms to.
Around middle and leg, defended from the crease.
Full and outside off, angling away, left alone.
LOKESH RAHUL walks in at number 4, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Kohli picks his man to perfection! The Indian skipper has a wry smile on his face. It was a poor delivery and should have been dispatched, but instead, it has resulted in a wicket. A fuller delivery, on the pads, Kohli flicks it beautifully with nice timing but it is uppish. Dushmantha Chameera has a few paces to cover to his left from fine leg and he does that well, cupping the ball near his tummy. Kohli cannot believe it. Sri Lanka will not mind. India rocked early. 199 more needed from 269 balls.
On a length outside off, moving away, VK pushes it behind point for one. 9 runs from that over.
WIDE. Will have to re-bowl that one. A bouncer but misdirected, down the leg side and too high as well.
Slants this on the pads, comfortably tucked through square leg for a run. Moves to 10 from 17 balls.
FOUR! SLAUGHTERED! Short and wide outside off, slower in pace, Rohit camps on his back foot and crashes it past a diving point to his right for a boundary!
Keeps this in line of the stumps, Virat gets across, stays in his crease and tucks it wide of mid on for a single.
Full and outside off, swinging away a touch, Kohli comes forward and drives it sweetly but it is intercepted nicely by the man at short extra cover to his right.
Slants this on the pads, Rohit clips this to deep square leg for a single.

Maiden from Fernando! And that too against Virat Kohli, brilliant! This is good stuff from the youngster, who backs up his senior man with a tight over. Fuller around off, pushed gently to mid off for no run. This will sustain the pressure on the Indians!
Wide outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Full and straight on middle, defended with the angle to covers.
Angling across Kohli, who goes after it but misses. He has to be more careful as he has the habit of being drawn into off drives.
Slanting across from Kohli, he looks to defend with a straight bat but gets it off the outer half to covers.
Fuller on middle and leg, defended from within the crease.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharma gets on his toes and blocks it away.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length delivery outside off, tapped to point.
Back of a length delivery, defended on the off side.
Kohli gets off the mark with a gentle dab in the mid-wicket region for a single.
Virat Kohli is the new man in.

OUT! Chopped on! Length delivery, angling away. Dhawan stays back to glide it away but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. That's a massive, massive blow for India. This is the first time Dhawan has got out on a single digit against Sri Lanka in ODIs. Finally, Malinga strikes! He now moves to 299 ODI wickets.

NOT OUT! Big inside edge! On a length around leg, angling away. Sharma looks to defend but misses and is rapped on the pads. The players go up in appeal but the umpire stays put. Dickwella is confident and urges his skipper to take the review. Kapugedera obliges. The replays shows there to be a massive inside edge and the Snicko confirms it. Waste of a review from the hosts and they have lost it now.
Sri Lanka have taken the review against Rohit Sharma after he was adjudged not out to an lbw appeal. It seems to be pitching outside leg. Let's see...
Fuller around leg, pushed to mid on.
Full around leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
Slanting away from the batsman, Sharma defends it with the angle to point.
Wide outside off, glided behind square on the off side for a single.

FOUR! No stopping this man! Fernando delivers it full and straight, Dhawan just leans into the shot and creams his drive through covers for a boundary. He is in that kind of form where he doesn't even need to get his eye in.
Vishwa Fernando to bowl with the second new ball. He too has a couple of slips in place.
Fuller this time on middle, pushed from within the crease to mid on.
Length delivery outside off, played on the up to point.
On a good length outside off, dabbed to point.
FOUR! Solid punch! Another back of a length delivery outside off, Sharma stays in the crease and smashes it off the back foot through the gap in covers for a boundary. Feel-good shot for Rohit!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharma fails to get the timing right as he punches it to covers.
Full outside off, swinging away a touch, Sharma prods forward and taps it to covers.
We are back for the chase! Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan to open the batting. They will face Lasith Malinga first up, who has two slips in place. Here we go...
